name: oneup-for-social-media
description: OneUp is a social media management tool. Schedule posts to 12 social networks, reply to comments and inbox messages, and review analytics for the social accounts connected to your OneUp account.

interface.longDescription:
OneUp is a social media management tool for marketers, agencies, and small businesses. This plugin lets you manage the social media accounts connected to your OneUp account directly from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Schedule text, image, and video posts to X (Twitter), Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest, Reddit, YouTube, Google Business Profile, Snapchat, Threads, and Bluesky.
- Review, edit, and delete scheduled and draft posts, check published and failed posts, and reschedule failed posts.
- Read comments on your published posts, reply to posts and comments, and delete comments.
- Read and reply to Social Inbox conversations for Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, and mark conversations read or change their status.
- View analytics for a connected account, including overview metrics, post performance, audience demographics, and Meta Ads campaigns, and request an analytics refresh.
- Browse trending TikTok and Instagram sounds to add to posts.

ChatGPT confirms the content and target account with you before publishing, sending, editing, or deleting anything.

Requirements and limitations:
- You need a OneUp account with at least one connected social profile. You sign in to OneUp once to authorize access.
- Only accounts already connected in OneUp are available. New social profiles are connected in the OneUp web app.
- Available features vary by platform. For example, LinkedIn analytics are available for organization pages only, and the Social Inbox supports Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.
- Analytics reflect data stored in OneUp and may lag behind the social platforms until refreshed.
defaultPrompt: Schedule a post to my LinkedIn page for tomorrow at 9am announcing our new product launch
Show my Instagram analytics for the last 30 days
Show me the latest comments on my social media posts
